newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev softens to 382-383 per dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev softens to 382-383 per dlr at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed around 382-383 per dollar, down from 370-372 in early morning trade, as a final client bid for large dollar volumes which the central bank did not meet, dealers said.
"A large fuel importer bid for $6-7 million and the the lev lost 12-13 (levs) in a single day, due to low hard currency supply," a commercial bank dealer said.
The central bank sold small dollar volumes around 372 levs in the morning but as foreign currency demand remained too high, it withdrew from the market, traders said.
Demand for $2-3 million pressed the lev to 366-367 at the close on Monday from 362-364 in the morning, dealers said.
According to traders, the final client's foreign currency bids were not fully covered and the strong pressure on the lev is expected to continue in the next few days.
